verdict.rationale: n8n documents a REST API (n8n-docs-16) and a CLI (n8n-docs-17/probe-4), suggesting some programmatic control beyond the UI, but there's no evidence detailing full feature parity between the API and the visual editor (e.g., building/editing every node type, credentials, executions, admin settings via API), and a probe for an OpenAPI spec at standard paths returned 404s, suggesting the API surface may not be fully discoverable or documented as complete. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples showing full CRUD parity for workflows/credentials/executions/settings via API, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that API-only workflows can replicate all UI capabilities.
